subject: english
stem: A medicine test involved adult volunteers only. Which conclusion is outside the evidence?
options: The results apply directly to the tested adults.
Children were not part of this sample.
The medicine is safe for all children.
The adults in the test were volunteers.

optionRationales.reason: The results apply directly to the tested adults.：範圍相符。
Children were not part of this sample.：由 adult only 支持。
The medicine is safe for all children.：樣本無 children，不能推兒童安全。
The adults in the test were volunteers.：直接明示。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「結論的每個範圍詞與因果強度都不超過文中方法和結果」可推出 The medicine is safe for all children.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The medicine is safe for all children. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
